sections.text_helper: Section 35.1 "TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 introduction" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1334.
sections.section_content:
The TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 timers consist of a 16-bit autoreload counter driven by a
programmable prescaler.
They may be used for a variety of purposes, including measuring the pulse lengths of input
signals (input capture) or generating output waveforms (output compare, PWM,
complementary PWM with dead-time insertion).
Pulse lengths and waveform periods can be modulated from a few microseconds to several
milliseconds using the timer prescaler and the RCC clock controller prescalers.
The TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 timers are completely independent, and do not share any
resources. TIM15 can be synchronized as described in Section35.5.33: Timer
synchronization (TIM15 only).
